title: Transport of normalized integral Hom counits
statement: For every normalized TensorPresentation a of the derived tensor over a pro-etale ring sheaf, there exist a closed native structure S on the recorded derived internal Hom and a natural isomorphism e from a.tensor to the tensor with its two arguments exchanged, such that the counit of a is the transport of S's counit along e for every K and W.

source.place: Lemma 08J9, K-flat tensor-Hom comparison and evaluation normalization.

proof.text: Apply the closed symmetric monoidal construction to the derived category of R-modules and restrict its tensor comparison to the product of K-flat complexes.
Use full faithfulness of the product localization to lift the ratio between the native comparison and a.representative to a natural isomorphism from a.tensor to the exchanged native tensor.

On K-flat source representatives and K-injective targets, TensorPresentation.evaluation and the native signed Hom-tensor calculation give equal counits. K-flat and K-injective resolutions extend the equality to all derived objects.

mathlib_searches.query: tensor-Hom counit transport through a natural tensor isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: No exact TensorPresentation theorem; the native CoefficientClosedStructure APIs provide the underlying counit naturality.

from.place: Proof decomposition: comparison of a supplied normalized presentation with native closed evaluation.

lean.statement: theorem tensorPresentation_counit_transport (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (a : TensorPresentation.{u, u} X R) : ∃ S : CoefficientClosedStructure (hom.{u, u} X R), ∃ e : a.tensor ≅ swapTensor S.tensor, ∀ (K W : Derived.{u, u} X R), transportedCounit X R a S e K W = (a.adjunction K).counit.app W
